name: ephemeris
description: Probabilistic time-series forecasts (sales, demand, traffic, load, prices, metrics) from Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5, Toto 2, TiRex-2 and IBM Granite models, singly or as an accuracy-weighted ensemble. Adds the Ephemeris MCP server and a forecasting skill.

api_key.title: Ephemeris API key
api_key.description: Starts with pc_live_. Create one at https://ephemeris.cascade.industries/dashboard/api-keys after signing up.
